metadata.description: Process and human interaction modeling, tasks, roles, and handoffs

hasStep.description: Identifies a step defined within a process; process structure does not establish that any execution of the step occurred.

precedes.description: Defines the intended order from one process step to another; it does not establish observed execution order, and the validator does not enforce acyclicity.

createsTask.description: Identifies a task created from a process step; the link records work provenance rather than task execution or completion.

performedByRole.description: Assigns the role responsible for performing a process step; this responsibility declaration does not identify an actual performer or execution.

assignedToPerson.description: Identifies the individual assigned a task; assignment does not establish acceptance, execution or completion.

governedBy.description: Identifies a policy intended to govern a process or step; the declaration does not establish actual enforcement or compliance.

handsOffTo.description: Defines a handoff of work or responsibility from one step to another; an actual transfer requires separate observation evidence.

participatesIn.description: Identifies a person observed participating in an interaction; participation alone does not establish responsibility or decision authority.

memberOfTeam.description: Records a person's membership in a team in the cited context; membership alone does not assign a role or task.

followsStep.description: Associates an observed interaction with the process step it follows; observation evidence is required and the link does not certify overall process compliance.
